title: Newmark Arranges $31 Million Off-Market Sale of 3137 East Elwood Street in Phoenix to Sierra Ridge Capital

body_markdown:
***Photo credit to Mark Yori* October 14, 2026 12:00 PM**
Newmark announces the Company has arranged the $31 million sale of 3137 East Elwood Street, a 123,032-square-foot industrial building situated on approximately 9.8 acres in Phoenix’s Southbank Business Park, to Sierra Ridge Capital, a Los Angeles-based industrial investment and management firm. The property was fully leased to three tenants at closing, and the transaction was completed off-market prior to a formal marketing process.


Newmark Managing Director[Gary Cornish](https://www.nmrk.com/people/gary-cornish) and Associate[Nico Burgarello](https://www.nmrk.com/people/nico-burgarello) , in collaboration with Executive Managing Directors[Barry Gabel](https://www.nmrk.com/people/barry-gabel) ,[CJ Osbrink](https://www.nmrk.com/people/charles-j-osbrink) and[Chris Marchildon](https://www.nmrk.com/people/chris-marchildon) , led the assignment on behalf of the seller, 3137 East Elwood, LLC, an Arizona-based private investor and business owner. The buyer is Sierra Ridge Capital.


The transaction marks the culmination of a full-cycle assignment for the Newmark team, which originally sold the property to the current seller in 2024. During the approximately two-year hold period, ownership completed a significant office-to-industrial conversion and capital improvement program, transforming the asset into a highly functional industrial facility. Newmark subsequently leased the building to full occupancy before facilitating its sale on behalf of the same client.


“This sale is a great example of what a well-executed office-to-industrial conversion can deliver,” said Cornish. “We had the privilege of selling this building to our client in 2024, and in roughly two years they transformed it into a fully leased, highly functional industrial asset. Sierra Ridge Capital recognized how rare it is to find 100% HVAC space with heavy power, secured yard space and heavy industrial zoning in a central infill location with immediate freeway access.”


“3137 East Elwood is exactly what we are focused on acquiring at Sierra Ridge Capital: a highly functional industrial building in a central infill location where developable land is scarce,” said Nick Angelich, Co-Managing Partner at Sierra Ridge Capital. “Its power, gated yard and full HVAC meet the needs of traditional distribution, contractor and service users, as well as the advanced manufacturing and technology companies reshaping Phoenix’s economy. We appreciate Gary and the Newmark team for delivering a clean, off-market execution, and we are excited to continue growing our presence in Greater Phoenix.”


The acquisition marks Sierra Ridge Capital’s first investment in Arizona, and the firm is actively pursuing additional opportunities throughout Greater Phoenix. The property’s central location, extensive improvements, secured yard space, heavy power capacity, and full HVAC coverage aligned with Sierra Ridge’s strategy of acquiring functional industrial assets in supply-constrained markets.


Built in 1995 and renovated in 2026, the property features approximately 22-foot clear heights, 10 oversized grade-level loading doors and one truckwell. Located within Southbank Business Park, minutes from Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport, and directly adjacent to Interstate 10 and near Interstate 17 and State Route 143, the asset provides strategic access to the Greater Phoenix region.


**About Sierra Ridge Capital**
Sierra Ridge Capital is a Los Angeles-based private real estate investment and asset management firm focused on industrial properties in the western U.S. The firm invests as a principal alongside institutional, family office and private capital partners, and operates assets on behalf of ownership groups. Sierra Ridge emphasizes well-located assets acquired at a durable basis and managed for long-term income growth. Founded in 2025, the firm has recently acquired a 113,500-square-foot warehouse in Los Angeles’ San Fernando Valley and a four-property, 238,473-square-foot light industrial portfolio in Riverside, California. With the acquisition of 3137 East Elwood Street, Sierra Ridge’s portfolio totals approximately 475,000 square feet across California and Arizona. For more information, visit[www.sierraridgecap.com](http://www.sierraridgecap.com/) .
